lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Commander,

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: are you still sleeping?

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: I haven't been able to reach you, and I'm starting to get a little worried. :/
I'm awake.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Oh my!

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: You're finally awake!

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: I was gonna come find you if you didn't reply.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Yesterday, you even passed out for a bit,

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: and by the end, you pretty much just fell asleep on me.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: So even after I got back to my room, I couldn't stop worrying about you! :/
Sorry for worrying you.
Thanks to you, I slept really well. I feel totally refreshed.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: I'm so glad to hear that! ^.^

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Oh yeah, Commander,

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: do you remember me talking about perfumes yesterday?
Yeah, of course.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: I made a bunch of new perfumes today.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: If you're free, can you drop by my room for a bit?

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: I really want to give you one you like.
All right, I'll be right over.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Thanks, hehe!

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: I'll be waiting.
